This is a mid-level Software Engineer II role doing full-stack web development for Metronet's fiber-optic technology and operations teams, building internal business and operational applications. The work centers on React front ends, Node.js back ends, and RESTful APIs, with a notable emphasis on custom mapping and geospatial functionality. The core stack is JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and Node.js, with Esri/ArcGIS and similar geospatial or visualization libraries as adjacent technologies.
